text:
alex: Heads-up: I ran a quick FP8/GPTQ/AWQ sweep on opt-1.3b across SQuAD/dev and a small chat eval. Need to package quant profiles so Redwood Optimize can surface recommended profiles with clear failover semantics. Any opinions on naming + required metadata?

marta: Nice. For naming I'd favor explicit model+backend+quant+version, eg `opt-1.3b__gptq_awq__v0.1`. Keep separators double-underscore to avoid collisions. Also include `accuracy_delta` and `latency_p50` in metadata.

devin: Agree. Also include `eval_suite` (hash or name), `quant_bits`, `calib_data` pointer, and `fallback_model` (eg: opt-1.3b_fp16). We should encode SLO tags like `latency<=100ms`.

alex: Proposed minimal JSON profile (paste):
```json
{
  "profile_id": "opt-1.3b__gptq_awq__v0.1",
  "model": "opt-1.3b",
  "backend": "gptq+awq",
  "quant_bits": "int8/awq4",
  "eval_suite": "squad_v1_small_chat_2026-02-15",
  "metrics": {"squad_exact": "-1.2%", "chat_f1": "-0.8%", "latency_p50_ms": "85"},
  "rollout": {"safe_threshold_pct": "-2.0", "fallback": "opt-1.3b_fp16"},
  "summary": "GPTQ+AWQ combo reduces cost ~3.5x with small SQuAD delta",
  "recommendation_reason": "Good tradeoff for read-heavy QA routes"
}
```

nate: Keep `profile_manifest` with `created_by`, `created_at`, and `signature` (for integrity). Also versioning: semver-ish for profile metadata e.g., v0.1 -> v1.0 when stable.

opt-bot: optimize-bot uploaded artifact `profiles/opt-1.3b/gptq_awq/v0.1/quant_profile.json` :white_check_mark:

marta: :eyes: Can we also add `batching_hint` and `kv_cache_compat`? Some AWQ builds require kv cache warmup.

devin: One more operational note: Redwood Optimize UI expects a short `summary` and `recommendation_reason` string for non-ML folks. Also `cost_multiplier` (approx relative token cost) helps product decisions.

alex: Sounds good. I'll draft a schema PR for the profile format (will include examples for FP8/GPTQ/AWQ and a fallback policy). Plan: store under `profiles/<model>/<backend>/vX.Y/` and expose through Optimize API. I'll ping @nate for signature integration.

nate: Thanks — will check the PR tomorrow. If anyone has specific experiment logs, drop them in the thread or link the S3 artifact.

opt-bot: upload link: https://s3.redwood.internal/bench/opt-1.3b/1769004321/bakeoff-results.json
